title: Bragantino vs Bahia: The Round That Grabs Attention

subtitle: The Clash That Kicks Off the Championship's Final Phase

author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
In the final phase of the Brasileirão, Red Bull Bragantino opens the 26th round by hosting Bahia in Bragança Paulista, at 4 PM. The encounter, scheduled for Saturday evening, September 5th, generates great interest among fans. The match will be broadcast on Premiere, with live coverage.

What Changes in Your Pocket When the Match Begins

The game is part of the Série A schedule, where Bragantino and Bahia face each other on the same Saturday night. The event draws attention for being the first match of the round, marking the beginning of the championship's final phase. The clash will be shown on Premiere, ensuring access for fans who follow the Brasileirão in real-time.

The Clash Between Braga and Bahia in the 26th Round

Red Bull Bragantino, who already won the Série B title last season, hosts Bahia, who is fighting to maintain its position in the standings. The match will be held in Bragança Paulista, at Bragantino's arena, and will mark the opening of the Brasileirão's 26th round.

Where to Watch Live

The live broadcast of the match between Bragantino and Bahia is available on Premiere, allowing fans to follow the game's unfolding in real-time. The coverage will be provided by the Premiere channel, with live commentary and analysis.

Other Matches of the 26th Round

In addition to the match between Bragantino and Bahia, the 26th round features other prominent clashes, such as the classic Fluminense x Vasco, which will be shown on Sportv and Premiere at 9 PM, and the match between São Paulo and Atlético-MG, which will also be broadcast on Premiere at 6:30 PM.

Full Saturday Schedule

  • 4 PM – Red Bull Bragantino x Bahia – Premiere
  • 6:30 PM – São Paulo x Atlético-MG – Premiere
  • 9 PM – Fluminense x Vasco – Sportv e Premiere

With information from ge, LANCE!, VEJA.
